parent-128-coverage.json.verification_scope: Read-only source review; main physics contract tests only. No full-suite, real solver, renderer, browser, paid provider, or production acceptance run.
gaps_and_corrections: **Initial registration is not the lifecycle.** #138 can close only for its exact real-file foundation scope; retain #139/#140 technical import/validation, #141 crash/concurrency/index/GC controls, #142 immutable version lifecycle and scoped resolution, and #143 compatibility/locks/replacement. Byte presence, SemVer or matching bone names do not establish technical compatibility. Preserve the source file and conversion lineage when normalization creates a derivative.

**All categories need usable consumers.** Section 4 covers character meshes/rigs/morphs, animation state machines/layers/events, environments/prefabs, textured PBR/shader definitions, lights/cameras and extensions. Generic kind enums do not deliver these. #140/#149 must map each advertised kind to actual validation, stored payloads, dependency resolution and a working consumer. Conditional formats (USD, Alembic, FBX and geometry-only formats) remain explicitly capability-dependent; mandatory GLB/glTF and exercised Blender interoperability must not be downgraded.

**Generation has a concrete local requirement.** Section 16 requires a local Blender procedural generator for a subset of real demonstration geometry. Explicitly retain this in #139/#151 and map external Model3D acquisition to its owning program. A provider-neutral interface alone cannot satisfy local geometry creation or establish paid/external provider support. Imported, generated, procedural and test-fixture origins must stay distinct.

**Search and browser are real workflows.** #144 needs usable offline lexical/metadata/compatibility search, stable filtering/sorting/pagination and explainable matching. Embeddings are optional actual providers with model/version and authorized disclosure; keywords are not embeddings. #145/#146 need real geometry/motion/material previews, dependency-bound cache keys, offline locally delivered viewer resources, keyboard/error/WebGL-fallback behavior, actual user operations and browser evidence. A thumbnail cannot make missing content ready.

**Safety is required before execution.** #150/#152's late placement must not defer path/URI/script/resource defenses until after unsafe import/render jobs exist. #139 owns import admission; #141 owns transactions and deletion reachability; #146 owns API/HTML defenses. #150 supplies shared job/cancellation/progress/retry controls early enough for each consumer. Preserve the final hardening gate as integration verification; avoid a competing controller.

**Package and license readiness are independent.** #148 must prove exact transitive closure, required source/license evidence, manifests as inventories of actual bytes, multipart corruption/order/missing-fragment rejection, extra-member policy, isolated restoration and exact-hash repair. Unknown redistribution rights cannot become approval through technical verification. Diagnostic opening of incomplete packages is permitted; production-ready resolution is not.

**Historical availability must be refreshed.** Original §§2/18 quote a historical missing-media situation. Main's later recovery documentation supersedes the blanket historical blocker. Do not fabricate replacement media or suppress failing verifiers; cite the exact presently unavailable payload if one is demonstrated. This review did not rerun the full historical source-verification workload and does not create a new current availability claim.

**Cross-project identity and instance identity differ.** #149 must bind exact immutable versions across two different scenes while keeping each instance's local transform, animation and overrides independent. Shared mutable aliases must not retroactively rewrite snapshots. Legacy adapters must preserve native IDs/reviews/source bytes and not force 2D into 3D schemas. Native scene references alone are insufficient.

**Mandatory CI cannot be an optional skip.** #152 must run the real Blender end-to-end proof in at least one pinned reproducible CI environment. Local absence may skip optional local execution only; missing mandatory proof prevents completion. Include browser testing, runtime/schema parity, resource/security/concurrency/failure tests and supported platform evidence. Retained baseline counts are revision-specific, not fresh full-suite results.

**Retain full acceptance granularity.** #151/#152 explicitly own §28 stages A–G and §31. Do not reduce them to “export works” or “scene renders”: real character + skeleton + skeletal motion + textured material + environment + prop + camera/lights; discover/inspect; two distinct scenes sharing exact versions; multiple real rendered frames; verified GLB/rig/animation and full dependency package; empty-library restoration to another absolute path; both scenes animate and rerender; compare identity, versions, topology, rig/channels, texture/material/dependency hashes, counts and image content under documented tolerances. Then remove a required payload, identify it exactly, reject readiness/unsafe restore, restore only the expected bytes, and verify success. Fixture evidence is not human art approval.

The existing leaf coverage is broadly faithful: #151 explicitly preserves two-scene rendering and exact missing-payload recovery; #152 explicitly preserves mandatory pinned Blender CI and browser/security/regressions. The corrections above should be added as explicit acceptance traceability within existing issues, not competing replacement issues. No new backlog item is justified merely because the original parent is broad.

parent-153-coverage.json.verification_scope: Read-only source review; main physics contract tests only. No full-suite, real solver, renderer, browser, paid provider, or production acceptance run.
gaps_and_corrections: **Keep one spatial authority.** §5.1 *prefers* Z-up; it does not override mandatory reuse of actual repository contracts. `physics_contracts.py:22/29` imports `rig_contracts.COORDINATES`, uses +Y-up gravity `[0,-9.81,0]`, meters/radians and XYZW. `rig_contracts.py:8` is the shared authority. Accept this documented choice and require tested Blender `(x,y,z) -> (x,-z,y)` basis/gravity/inertia/rotation conversion. Do not globally flip existing rigs or reclassify correct Y-up behavior as a violation. Existing 2D pixels and audio contracts stay unchanged.

**Contract fields are not capability claims.** #167's bodies/constraints/cloth/gas/liquid/cache schemas create configuration semantics only. #168 must actually probe specific features using real execution, distinguishing discovery from verified readiness and backend version from adapter version. #169 must prove the effective solver timestep, rational `30000/1001` sampling, full-step brackets/interpolation and same-environment tolerances. Source `document_hash` is a full-document hash, not a selective cache key. A valid cache manifest with a path does not prove saved bytes or replay.

**Complete rigid behavior remains #170/#171.** Preserve off-center force/torque, inertia, mass-independent free-fall, impulse/angular response, gravity-off, damping/sleep/wake/resting, actual contact/friction/restitution and collision masks/exclusions. Falling transforms from a backend smoke test do not cover these. Unsupported dynamic concave geometry, tunneling/CCD, sensors, queries and contact data must be truthful; lack of a queried contact manifold cannot silently become claimed support. Physical material combination arithmetic must match the actual backend or be rejected.

**Mechanics and actor interactions need solver evidence.** #172 must validate joint anchors/limits/motors/stability through physical constraints. #173 distinguishes dynamic/kinematic/root-motion authority and geometry-constrained walking/jumping/slopes/walls from authored clips; torso collision is not foot planting. #174 must preserve stable prop/actor IDs, event order, world transform and release linear/angular velocity continuity, collision restoration and two-character handoff. A fixed attachment/Bezier throw is not a complete physical interaction.

**Retain every category, not only the combined-demo subset.** #175 requires both wind-driven flag and moving-character garment; #176 real impact deformation; #177 physical lag/overshoot/damped settling; #178 actual births/lifetimes/seeded particle trajectories; #179 both smoke and fire with evolving gas caches; #180 volumetric liquid/container/mesh evolution; #182 explicit physical threshold or declared authored trigger followed by real fragment dynamics. Static fog, shaders, sprite particles, sinusoidal cloth and static debris cannot substitute. Conditional backend support must remain visible and must not be counted as executed passing categories.

**Coupling is directional.** #181/#183 must name fully coupled, one-way, sequential, bake-driven or unsupported edges and test them. Wind affecting cloth does not prove rigid-body wind; an obstacle affecting fluid does not prove fluid pushes the obstacle. Independent solvers without state/force exchange are not fully coupled. Preserve actual upstream cache identities and dependency invalidation.

**Move minimal safety/recovery into early execution.** The original roadmap says shared infrastructure early. Although #187 is a late integration stage, timeout, memory/disk/geometry admission, isolation, cancellation ownership and nonfinite diagnostics must precede every real job in #168 onward. Likewise #184's dependency on full coupling #183 must not prevent earlier rigid-body cache integrity/replay/restart protection. Integrate these primitives early under their existing owners, retain later full-category tests, and avoid duplicate worker/controller authorities. Final review should distinguish this sequencing correction from unauthorized deletion of dependency gates.

**Do not overclaim resume or cache identity.** #184 requires actual file inventories/hash checks, atomic state transitions, corruption/partial-output tests, last-good preservation and killing an actual backend process. Resume is allowed only when all required solver state is restorable; otherwise report clean restart. Render exposure/resolution/color-only changes should preserve independent physics caches; collider/gravity/motion/upstream changes invalidate affected bakes. Complete native Blender cache compatibility is version-bound.

**Animation/render bridge is still real work.** #185 must preserve original physics scene plus separately versioned baked output; exact time/coordinate/quaternion semantics; verified import/export for the actual format; geometry/native caches for deformations that glTF cannot represent; multi-shot continuity without camera-cut world resets; arbitrary requested-frame replay without recomputation. Silent MP4/WebM stream inventories require FFprobe verification when encoding occurs. Do not remove legacy 2D audio to achieve 3D silence.

**Browser labels and controls must be honest.** #186 must implement working control/status/inspection and physical debug overlays, with meaningful unavailable behavior. Imported cached states are “baked replay,” not a browser solver. Approximate editor preview, live backend simulation, fixture output, rendered output and human visual approval remain separate.

**Mandatory final acceptance is larger than the laboratory.** #188's laboratory must include real environment/ground/obstacles, actor pickup/carry/throw/contact, cloth, particles, at least one real selected environmental effect, multiple cameras/shots and cache-driven renders; video is required when the intended pipeline is available. Separately execute all category examples and gates A–L, including both smoke/fire and liquid under supported backend availability. Optional advanced content in the *combined scene* does not make the separate soft-body/hair/destruction category gates optional.

**Evidence remains per feature and per environment.** #189 must retain §21's complete per-feature checklist: contract, backend, executed solver, capability, unsupported handling, budgets, self-contained example, real cache/state, renderable output, numerical tests, invalidation/failure handling, docs and regressions. Preserve tests for real interruption/relocation/platform behavior, inspect beginning/middle/end frames, numerical state changes, measured resource reports and replay/recompute tolerances. Mocks or a fixture JSON matching itself cannot pass a backend gate; an automated image metric cannot assert human review.

The existing leaves broadly preserve the original mission through explicit original-section references. Add the above detail to existing leaf acceptance/traceability where shorthand could mislead. There is no basis to close the parent or mark omitted categories complete, and no need to create a competing physics program.
